items.name: theme
items.title: Factory DS theme
items.description: Token CSS variables (light, dark, high contrast; comfortable, compact), Tailwind v4 utilities without the default theme, and base styles. Import the three files once.

items.name: axis
items.title: Axis
items.description: Chart axis (ticks, labels, title, grid) drawn by the chart engine from the generated theme.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Short status text with a status colour, e.g. an order status.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action; primary, secondary and ghost variants.

items.name: chart-panel
items.title: Chart panel
items.description: A chart in a panel frame, written as Vega-Lite, Flint, a D3 chart or Plotly.

items.name: dashboard-template
items.title: Dashboard template
items.description: Title band, filter bar, then 12-column rows of panels; KPI band, primary chart, supporting charts.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Rows and columns with sorting, number formats and conditional formats; also the text alternative for every chart.

items.name: delta-indicator
items.title: Delta indicator
items.description: Direction glyph plus signed change, coloured positive or negative.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What a panel shows with no data, or when it fails.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: The dashboard filters, as chip groups and selects.

items.name: filter-chip
items.title: Filter chip
items.description: Toggle chip (aria-pressed) for one value of a multiselect filter.

items.name: formatted-value
items.title: Formatted value
items.description: A number formatted from a format token, in tabular numerals; an em dash when missing.

items.name: kpi-card
items.title: KPI card
items.description: One headline number in a panel.

items.name: kpi-value
items.title: KPI value with delta
items.description: A current value with its change against a comparison period.

items.name: legend
items.title: Legend
items.description: Chart legend drawn by the chart engine from the generated theme.

items.name: nav-card
items.title: Navigation card
items.description: Index-page link to one dashboard, listing its validation errors.

items.name: panel-frame
items.title: Panel frame
items.description: The card a panel sits in, with its title, body and an error boundary.

items.name: ranked-bars
items.title: Ranked bars
items.description: Top-N horizontal bars with direct value labels; a D3 chart used inside a chart panel.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Native single-choice dropdown, styled as a pill.

items.name: title-band
items.title: Title band
items.description: Page heading and description.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Extra text shown on hover and keyboard focus.
